audit_history_note: The initial Section 8 manifest verification invoked the repository-root-relative Section 2 and Section 3 manifests from incorrect working directories. The audit procedure was corrected without modifying scientific artifacts, and both artifact manifests and manifest-self hashes subsequently verified successfully.
documented_limitations: Exact client-process wall-clock duration is not independently reconstructible from archived repository artifacts; archived timestamps support reproducible request-span duration instead.
Per-run and within-condition groups contain only one true class, so two-class balanced accuracy is undefined for those groupings.
Fixed-label binary macro-F1 of 0.5 for single-class groupings reflects the absent second class and is not 50 percent classification accuracy.
Packet windows and requests are nested observations; the experimental unit is the run.
Mitigation is application-level HTTP 429 enforcement, not firewall, iptables, network-layer packet dropping, or source-IP blocking.

Exp011 supports claims only for the frozen controlled-laboratory topology and predefined benign and high-rate HTTP workloads; it does not establish production-scale or general DDoS mitigation effectiveness.
interpretation: Exp011 provides reproducible controlled-laboratory evidence of online packet-derived detection using the frozen Exp010 deployment-compatible classifier and actual model-triggered application-level mitigation. Claims beyond the audited controlled-laboratory scope remain unsupported.
